title: Quitting lessons after a rap on the knuckles
summary: A teacher hit his hands with a ruler for playing by ear, so he never went back; his mother let him decide, and the Hammond organ came later.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: -- I don't remember too much about that -- at that time I was one of the kids that played out. I took about 12 lessons and she found out that I was playing by ear, and she hit me on the hands with a ruler, so I never wanted to go back, and I was so young, about six, that --
My mother was never one to force us to do anything --
-- like that. And she said, well, if he wants bad enough he'll get it.
Well did you have a Hammond organ in the house in the beginning or did you --
A Hammond organ in the house or did your sister --
No, no, no. That was after when I used to go home --
I mean after I was out of town.
-- she got her degree in music -- and
Well when you went back home --
